title: LPS Distributes 1,000 Sembako Packages to Communities Affected by the Earthquake in Sikka, NTT
excerpt: LPS distributed 1,000 sembako (staple food) packages to communities affected by the earthquake in Sikka, NTT, through Relawan Nusantara to support post-disaster recovery. Read the full story!
seoTitle: 1,000 LPS Food Packs for Sikka Quake Survivors - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: LPS distributed 1,000 staple food packages to earthquake-affected communities in Sikka, NTT, through Relawan Nusantara to support post-disaster recovery.
html:
Recovery after an earthquake requires sustained support, including to meet the food needs of affected families. As a form of care for the people of Sikka Regency, Lembaga Penjamin Simpanan (LPS, the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation) distributed 1,000 sembako (staple food) packages through Relawan Nusantara.

The handover of the aid was marked by a ceremony involving LPS, Relawan Nusantara, and the Sikka Regency Government. This collaboration is part of the effort to help communities meet their basic needs during the post-disaster recovery period.

LPS and Relawan Nusantara Join Forces to Help Affected Communities

The aid handover was attended by the Assistant for Economy and Development at the Sikka Regency Regional Secretariat, who is also Acting Head of the Sikka Regency BPBD (Regional Disaster Management Agency), Petrus Poling Wairhaming, S.T., M.T., M.Sc. Meanwhile, LPS was represented online by KM. Nuruddin as Executive Director of Secretariat and Institutional Relations at LPS. Also attending online was Hikmah Fitriyani, S.T., M.M as Chief Program & Operational Officer of Relawan Nusantara.

The aid was handed over symbolically to 10 representatives of the beneficiaries. This handover marked the start of the distribution of 1,000 sembako packages to communities affected by the earthquake in Sikka Regency.

The Sikka Regency Government expressed its appreciation to LPS and Relawan Nusantara for the support given. The synergy between institutions, humanitarian organizations, and the local government is expected to help respond to the community's needs in facing the impact of the disaster.

Sembako Aid to Support Families' Recovery

In the midst of the post-disaster recovery process, food remains an important part of the daily lives of affected families. The sembako aid is expected to help ease household expenses so that people can meet some of their basic needs.

Through this distribution, LPS together with Relawan Nusantara seeks to bring tangible support to the people of Sikka Regency. More than just logistical aid, this collaboration reflects care and the spirit of gotong royong (mutual cooperation) in accompanying communities through the difficult period after the disaster.

Recovery efforts require the involvement of many parties so that the community's needs can continue to be met. The small steps we take together surely mean a great deal to our brothers and sisters who are rebuilding their lives. Let us together continue to care and channel kindness for their recovery through Pangan untuk NTT (Food for NTT).

Luaskan Manfaat
